
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jiazhengjing/p/20403498" title="发布于 2026-06-09 17:10">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">imx415 启动HDR场景</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>　　板卡型号：RV1126B</p>
<p>　　内核版本：6.1</p>
<p>　　摄像头型号：imx415</p>
<p>　　备注：标定文件要支持hdr</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="538" height="561" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260609163417703-1168667615.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>1、基于rockti demo启动hdr</h1>
<ul>
<li>rockit使用文件系统版本为：ubuntu24.04</li>
<li>测试demo：simple_vi_get_frame_rkaiq
<ul>
<li><span class="ne-text">-d参数可以指定为hdr2模式&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span class="ne-text">-d | --hdr_mode: Default:0, 0:normal, 1:hdr2</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 备注：启动demo前需要确保rkaiq_3A_server是没有运行的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>simple_vi_get_frame_rkaiq -d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> -I <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> -w <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1920</span> -h <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1080</span> -c <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">150</span> -o <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> -a /etc/iqfiles</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260609155026394-1023227542.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　dmesg | grep imx415&nbsp; 查看对应内核打印信息hdr模式确认为5，已启动hdr模式</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260609155715764-468828130.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　&nbsp;测试效果图如下：</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260609155925694-1369732456.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　　查阅simple_vi_get_frame_rkaiq源码，将hdr_mode赋值为RK_AIQ_WORKING_MODE_ISP_HDR2 ，通过rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_prepare&nbsp; api切换到主场景。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260609161247479-1018788018.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>2、<span class="ne-text">rkaiq_3A_server</span></h1>
<ul>
<li><span class="ne-text">可以基于gstreamer测试</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="lake-content">
<ul>
<li id="u6e6b710e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">源码：external/camera_engine_rkaiq/rkaiq_3A_server/rkaiq_3A_server.cpp</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u2f5efbd9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">　　RK_AIQ_WORKING_MODE_NORMAL将改为RK_AIQ_WORKING_MODE_ISP_HDR2 重新编译rkaiq_3A_server即可</span></p>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260609160836293-431008012.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>3、总结</h1>
<p><span class="mce-nbsp-wrap">&nbsp;　　&nbsp; &nbsp;启动hdr模式可以通过rkaiq_3a_server启动或者</span>应用程序调用librkaiq实现</p>
<p><span class="mce-nbsp-wrap">&nbsp;&nbsp;　　&nbsp;以上方法使用都可以使用这俩个api实现切换，详细参与原厂指南《Rockchip_Development_Guide_ISP35_CN.pdf》，具体api说明如下：</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span class="ne-text">rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_preInit_scene切换主场景/子场景</span></li>
<li>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260609162138290-669719402.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</li>
<li><span class="ne-text">rk_aiq_uapi2_sysctl_prepare这个是用于切换工作模式</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2988421/202606/2988421-20260609162222604-1914923413.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
